_comment: What the onboarding wizard's feed check matches and says, kept out of the code so a new feed type or a reworded refusal is a data edit. Structure stays in code: the order of the fetches, the <link> attributes read, how a name is made unique. Types match case-insensitively, against the part before any ';'.
_comment_types: feed_link_types: the <link rel="alternate"> types a home page names its feed with, RSS and Atom only, which are what both parsers read. html_types: the Content-Types of a page, as opposed to a feed, which decides whether a non-feed answer is refused as a page without a feed link or as not a feed at all.
_comment_messages: Each refusal the reader sees, in the page's words. {url} is the address that failed, which after a home page is the feed it linked; {reason}, {status} and {name} are filled in by the check.

messages.not_a_url: Paste a web address that starts with http:// or https://.
messages.unreachable: Could not reach {url} ({reason}). Check the address and try again.
messages.http_status: {url} answered HTTP {status}. Check the address, or paste the feed's own address.
messages.not_a_feed: {url} is not an RSS or Atom feed. Paste a feed's address, or a site's home page that links one.
messages.no_feed_link: The page at {url} links no RSS or Atom feed. Find the feed's own address on the site and paste that.
messages.no_articles: The feed at {url} has no articles, so there is nothing to read from it yet.
messages.already_listed: This feed is already in the list as {name}.
messages.not_public: {url} is on a private or local network, which this check does not fetch. Paste a public feed's address.
messages.too_many_redirects: {url} redirects too many times. Paste the feed's own address.
messages.too_large: The answer from {url} is too large to be a feed. Paste the feed's own address.
messages.encoded: {url} answered in a compressed form the check did not ask for. Paste the feed's own address.
